# Bundled third-party code

`waveshare_epd/` - the driver for the Waveshare 2.13" e-Paper HAT V4
(`epd2in13_V4.py`, `epdconfig.py`), copied unchanged from Waveshare's e-Paper
repository (https://github.com/waveshareteam/e-Paper,
`RaspberryPi_JetsonNano/python/lib/waveshare_epd/`). MIT licence: see the
header at the top of each file. Bundled so a new dock doesn't need the whole
Waveshare repository installed.
